result.summary: Found 2 layout issues: a restaurant name truncated mid-word in the Fastest near you carousel and a large empty gap under the pizza promo card.

issues.description: The third restaurant card title is cut off mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of showing the full name, and the delivery fee line is similarly incomplete in the card width.
issues.suggestion: Allow card titles to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or widen cards so full restaurant names and fee text remain readable without truncation.

issues.description: The bottom pizza promotional card shows only the image with a -20% badge and no restaurant name, rating, or meta info beneath it, leaving a large empty white space above the tab bar.
issues.suggestion: Ensure each restaurant/promo card consistently includes title and details below the image, or tighten vertical spacing if the content is intentionally off-screen.
